title: The Spellsparkler
summary: Quarterstaff that generates Lightning Charges from spell damage.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d6 Bludgeoning one-handed or 1d8 two-handed, plus Strength. Simple, versatile, dippable, 5 ft melee.
fields.Electric Veins: Gain 2 Lightning Charges on spell or cantrip damage. Each independent ray or missile can qualify; a simultaneous area hit does not generate separately for every target.
fields.Lightning Charges: While charged, +1 to attack rolls and +1 Lightning damage. At 5 charges, the next qualifying damage adds 1d8 Lightning and consumes the charges. Lose one per turn. Lightning-resistant targets do not take the flat +1 Lightning damage.
fields.Topple: Action with proficiency once per Short Rest. Melee attack for 1d4 nonlethal Bludgeoning. Dexterity save vs weapon-action DC +2 avoids one-turn Prone. No main-hand weapon effects.
fields.Acquisition: One of Florrick’s three rewards for rescuing her.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
